properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: Clave secreta para firmar tokens JWT. Debe ser una cadena Base64 segura.

properties.name: jwt.expiration
properties.description: Tiempo de expiración del token JWT en milisegundos (default: 1800000 = 30 minutos).

properties.name: redis.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable Redis components (RedisConfig, TokenBlacklistService, TrackingAdapter). Default is true. Set to false in test environments to run without Redis.

properties.name: app.storage.type
properties.description: Tipo de almacenamiento de archivos. Valores: 'local' (para dev/test), 'gcs' (para prod/dev cloud).

properties.name: app.storage.path
properties.description: Ruta local donde se guardan archivos cuando app.storage.type=local.

properties.name: app.ocr.mode
properties.description: Modo de operación del OCR. Valores: 'mock' (acepta todo), 'plate-recognizer' (especializado en placas).

properties.name: app.plate-recognizer.token
properties.description: Token de API de Plate Recognizer. Obtener en: https://platerecognizer.com/

properties.name: app.plate-recognizer.region
properties.description: Código de región para Plate Recognizer (ej: 'co' para Colombia).

properties.name: spring.flyway.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable flyway.

properties.name: spring.flyway.locations
properties.description: Locations of migrations scripts.

properties.name: spring.flyway.baseline-on-migrate
properties.description: Whether to automatically baseline a database when migrating.

properties.name: spring.flyway.baseline-version
properties.description: Version to tag an existing schema with when executing baseline (default: 1).

properties.name: spring.flyway.validate-on-migrate
properties.description: Whether to automatically call validate when performing a migration (default: true).

properties.name: spring.flyway.out-of-order
properties.description: Whether to allow migrations to be run out of order (default: false).

properties.name: cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-separated list of allowed origins for CORS.

properties.name: google.maps.api-key
properties.description: API Key de Google Maps Platform.

properties.name: google.cloud.storage.bucket-name
properties.description: Nombre del bucket de Google Cloud Storage (requerido si app.storage.type=gcs).

properties.name: google.cloud.storage.project-id
properties.description: ID del proyecto de Google Cloud.

properties.name: google.cloud.storage.signed-url-expiration-hours
properties.description: Duración en horas de las URLs firmadas de GCS (default: 24).

properties.name: tracking.update.interval
properties.description: Intervalo de actualización de ubicación en milisegundos (default: 30000 = 30 segundos).

properties.name: tracking.max.distance.validation
properties.description: Distancia máxima en metros para validar ubicación (default: 200m).

properties.name: tracking.history.retention.days
properties.description: Días de retención del historial de tracking (default: 30 días).

properties.name: websocket.allowed.origins
properties.description: Orígenes permitidos para conexiones WebSocket (separados por comas).

properties.name: spring.h2.console.enabled
properties.description: Habilita la consola de H2. Requerido como workaround para Spring Boot 4.x o configuración manual.

properties.name: spring.cloud.gcp.sql.instance-connection-name
properties.description: Cloud SQL instance connection name in the format: project-id:region:instance-id. Used by the Cloud SQL Socket Factory to establish connections from Cloud Run.

properties.name: spring.cloud.gcp.sql.database-name
properties.description: Name of the Cloud SQL database to connect to. Typically matches the value of DB_NAME environment variable.

properties.name: app.trash.retention-days
properties.description: Días que un servicio permanece en la papelera antes de ser eliminado permanentemente.

properties.name: app.trash.cleanup-cron
properties.description: Expresión cron para el job de limpieza de papelera. Por defecto: diariamente a las 3:00 AM.

properties.name: app.cookie.secure
properties.description: Habilita el flag Secure en cookies de autenticación. Debe ser true en producción (solo HTTPS), false en desarrollo/testing.

values.description: Almacenamiento en sistema de archivos local (para desarrollo/test).
